title: Skillet Quesadillas (Pulled Pork, BBQ Pulled Pork, Buffalo Chicken)
description: Burrito-size skillet quesadillas with three filling versions. 1 per person, 2 if hungry.
steps: Warm the filling in the microwave, covered, 1 to 2 min (add a splash of water or juice to pork or chicken so it doesn't dry out).
Heat a skillet over medium. Add the butter.
Lay the tortilla flat. Sprinkle half the cheese over one half, add filling, then the rest of the cheese. Fold over.
Cook 2 to 3 min until golden. Flip with a wide spatula, cook 2 to 3 min more until the cheese is fully melted.
Rest 1 min, cut into wedges. Chips on the side if you want.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R5
notes:
10 min.
Versions:
- Pulled pork: plain pulled pork, habanero jack, a few chopped candied jalapenos. Dip: BBQ sauce or sour cream.
- BBQ pulled pork: toss the pork with 2 to 3 Tbsp BBQ sauce. Habanero jack or provolone. Dip: ranch or extra BBQ.
- Buffalo chicken: toss shredded chicken with 2 to 3 Tbsp Buffalo sauce (R8). Half mozzarella, half habanero jack. Dip: ranch (blue cheese also good).
Too dark outside, cheese not melted? Turn heat down to medium-low and cover the pan for a minute.

healthy: Pulled pork or chicken filling gives protein.
not_healthy: Large flour tortilla is refined carbs.
3/4 cup shredded cheese adds saturated fat and sodium.
BBQ or Buffalo sauce fillings add sugar or sodium.
